articles.summary: Policies are versatile tools in Sails for authorization and access control. They give you the ability to execute some logic before an action is run for the purpose of ascertaining if the request should continue or not. This article will introduce policies in Sails, explain how to go about creating policies in Sails and the best practices to observe when doing so.
articles.title: Understanding Sails policies and best practices

articles.summary: Actions are Sails mechanisms that are responsible for responding and handling requests to your Sails applications. This article will introduce you to the actions2 style of writing actions in Sails and how to start using it in your Sails applications.
articles.title: Migrating your Sails actions to actions2
